        opt.add(s[nj] >= s[ni] + d[ni] + tij - M_big * If(y[(ni, nj)], 0, 1))
        opt.add(s[ni] >= s[nj] + d[nj] + tji - M_big * If(y[(nj, ni)], 0, 1))

total_duration = Sum([d[p["name"]] for p in people])
